clean.note: Process.terminate() (SIGTERM) does NOT produce a distinguishable 'clean' signature from mGBA — it terminates via the raw signal exactly like a crash. There is no observed graceful-quit path from an external Process.terminate() call; the shipping adapter host must not assume SIGTERM alone triggers a save-and-quit.
